| J7GDZ9 | Designed for humid summers | Automatic | Vinyl | Two | Y | A |
| JQWVF2 | Equipped with snow tracks | Automatic | Cloth | Four | Y | C |
| JHRKCE | Used at an Arctic station | Manual | Vinyl | Two | Z | B |

License plate: JHRKCE
Description: Used at an Arctic station
Transmission: Manual
Seat cover: Vinyl
Doors: Two
Which class, A, B, or C, does this vehicle belong to?

Output only a JSON object with the fields "first_value", "reasoning", and "final_answer". Write your reasoning in "reasoning". Set "final_answer" to A, B, or C. Your final answer may match or differ from the preliminary entry.
